primaryReview.rationale: Right native100 Y630..680 was traced independently with hippocampal attachment and turn into the crus as landmarks. The initial interpolation at Y647 entered a fissure; an explicit source-guided contour corrects this. Five final grid footprint planes were inspected. Of 849 candidates, 17 existing ID46 cells are unchanged, seven hippocampal-label cells and ten cavity-centre flags are held. One terminal cell at native Y679.7 is held for further continuation because it is isolated on the app grid. The remaining 814 additions preserve both existing side components. Approximate borders and partial volume are accepted; full bilateral fimbria and mammillary continuity are not claimed.
